notes.subject: עצרה
notes.rationale: 'assembly/festival' vs ylt 'restraint' — most render solemn assembly; Yehu orders a solemn festival for Baal.

notes.subject: mekim holi
notes.rationale: קדשו 'sanctify/keep holy' — Yehu's word carries cultic consecration of the assembly, not moral purity.

notes.subject: to ol man bilong Yisrael
notes.rationale: Yehu's imperative commands his officials to summon all Baal worshippers.

translation: Na Yehu i tok: Mekim holi wanpela olsem bilong olgeta man long Bet Baal. Ol i go na tokaut.
